svg.title: Sea Wolf ROM graphics byte-order study
svg.desc: Eleven original byte-exact raster records, viewed in normal and bit-reversed order at shift count zero; these are not complete composited game frames.
svg.text: Record bytes shown in both hardware bit orders at shift count zero
Raw data previews, not final screen pixels: the 8080 drawing routines also shift and place each byte.
Source: original Sea Wolf sw0044.e $0D3D-$0EB4. Normal or bit-reversed data at shift=0, not a gameplay screenshot.
